findings.issue: Verified final summary with optional null boxscore/drives/gameInfo/scoringPlays or null arrays raises and aborts the refresh run. Missing boxscore is currently labelled verified in the dataset provenance despite having no boxscore rows.
findings.recommendation: Safely parse optional typed containers, mark unavailable datasets explicitly, and retain prior verified final for structurally malformed retrievals.

findings.issue: --use-cache returns json.loads outside the protected retrieval path. Matching checksum metadata does not make malformed JSON readable.
findings.recommendation: Validate saved JSON shape before replay; reject malformed cache as unusable and retrieve safely or expose unavailable without crashing.

findings.issue: Details are installed before stable-input guard; index is installed before validate. Failed manual refresh leaves altered local report files and may replace index with a rejected snapshot.
findings.recommendation: Build in isolated staging, validate complete staged snapshot and stable input hashes, then install. Scheduled set-e prevents failed data from being committed, but does not provide local rollback.

acceptedBehavior: Verified event identity/season/team/home-away/final score gate excludes disputed detailed statistics
Missing numeric values stay null and real zero stays zero
Strict verified TLS context used for ordinary summary retrieval
Conditional validators and exact cache URL/hash validated
Temporary complete retrieval failure retains prior verified report, unchanged bytes and retrieval timestamps
Archive reuse avoids recrawl; explicit --refresh-history exists
--check binds current Team/Matchup body hashes and all report content hashes
--index-only metadata rebind performs no provider requests and refuses score/identity mismatch
No present-day injuries substituted for historical inactive lists
isolation: Controlled fixtures only under /workspace/recovery-qa/game-report-refresh-review; no provider requests or browser runs.
